evidence.requirements: Start page (list.jpg): heading, name links, family, L3, Search, Family select, '25 cartridges' (app.js:29-40, catalog.js:11-17). Detail: facts incl. capacity + source link (app.js:45-62), Cartridge/Chamber tables with Symbol/Value/Unit (app.js:64-79), Print button + 'All cartridges' (app.js:105-108), hash route #/cartridge/<key> survives reload. Drawing: inline SVG, role=img aria-label '<name> drawing' (drawing.js:304-305), section hatched, dash-dot centre line, dimensions L3/L6/R1/R/P1 and P2/H1/H2/G1/L1/L2/E1/α where published, title block with name/table/revised/'Dimensions in mm'/scale. Print one A4 page (print-308_win.jpg). Partly met: process artifacts (spec, plan, review) not delivered; 22 LR note names 'f' as missing though the rimfire rim edge doesn't use it.
evidence.correctness: geometry.js follows the rules: chamfer (106-108), rimfire half-round rho=min(R/2,(R1-P1)/2) (104,109-119), groove floor/ramp (130-141), belt ramp dz=dr/tan δ (136), body/shoulder through published points with r1Min/r2 fillets (158-164), walls tn/tb blended (204-213), w max (184-190), pockets (13-15), seating/k/meplat/ogive (16-17,235-260), heeled exposed=H2, heel H2/2-tb (248,271-273). Screenshots match references for 308_win, 300_win_mag, 9_mm_luger, 22_long_rifle. Values as published ('39.62 -0.2', '10°58'0"'). Issues: diameter dims all stacked right of tip with extension lines hugging the outline over the whole length (detail-308_win.jpg); 44 Rem. Mag. 'R 1.52' label displaced into the L6 lane (detail-44_rem_mag.jpg); spurious 'head chamfer (f)' note on 22 LR; units column says 'deg' next to values that already carry °.
evidence.security: All DOM built with createElement/textContent (app.js:15-26); SVG string inserted by innerHTML only after esc() of name/labels (drawing.js:15, 288-305); numbers only otherwise. No eval, no fetch; e2e aborts any non-file request (app.spec.js:13).
evidence.code_quality: Clear module split (data/format/catalog/geometry/drawing/app) with UMD wrappers for Node tests; pure geometry. layout() in drawing.js is ~290 lines of dense closures with terse names (u, fs, al, aw, ov) and long lines; error handling for missing core values (geometry.js:87-88) and notes for missing features.
evidence.tests: Unit tests check every geometry rule numerically (geometry.test.js: rim thresholds, chamfer cap, belt ramp, rimfire half-round, fillets, walls, w, pockets, seating/k/m per shape, ogive radius, ellipse, heeled, missing-value notes). drawing.test.js checks labels, title block, scale, and no label/line overlap for all 25 records at 4 widths. format/catalog tests cover tolerances, symbols, units, search by alt names. E2E covers list, search, filter, reload, print call, DOM bbox overlaps, one-page PDF for all 25, and no network. Last run passed.
evidence.ux_design: Dense, calm technical sheet: facts grid, framed drawing with title block, two-column grouped tables (detail-308_win.jpg). Print is a compact one-page sheet with three table columns (print-308_win.jpg). Weaknesses: drawing label text ~10px on desktop; diameter labels sit in a staircase far from their features, so readers must trace long extension lines; dark mode not visible in screenshots.
evidence.accessibility: SVG role=img + aria-label + desc; tables have caption and th scope col/row; labelled search/select; count has role=status; focus moved to h1 on route change; focus-visible outlines; lang=en. Small uppercase table headers (0.68rem) and small drawing text; muted text contrast adequate.
evidence.simplicity: Plain HTML/CSS/JS, no runtime deps, one dev dep (@playwright/test). ~900 lines of app JS for geometry, layout with collision avoidance and routing, appropriate to the problem.
evidence.maintainability: No README, no docs/ADRs/specs, no CI config, no engines/.nvmrc; @playwright/test uses a caret range (lockfile present). playwright.config.js resolves a Chromium binary from ~/.cache with --no-sandbox, an undocumented environment assumption. Good regression tests and npm scripts (test, test:e2e, serve) partly compensate.
evidence.visual_design: Consistent restrained palette, tabular numbers, monospace symbols, uppercase micro-headings, crisp title block (all detail screenshots). Looks finished; drawing text is small relative to the page and the vertical dim stack is visually busy.
evidence.layout: Most important content first: name, facts, drawing, tables. No overlaps or clipping seen in any screenshot. Some empty space left of the title block in the drawing frame; print leaves blank space below tables but fits one page.
evidence.usability: Live search with alternative names and decimal-comma normalisation, family filter, count, direct links, bookmarkable hash routes, not-found page, Print button. Minor: '1 cartridges' wording; no sorting.
evidence.reception: Engineers and reloaders would trust the true-scale section drawing, C.I.P.-style title block and complete tables; the clean print sheet is useful. Small drafting conventions (dimension placement) and the spurious note slightly undercut the polish.

unmet_requirements: Process artifacts (spec, plan, review documentation) required by the brief's Process section are not present in the repository
22 Long Rifle shows 'Not drawn, value missing: head chamfer (f)' although the rimfire rim edge needs no f (misleading missing-value note)
strengths: Geometry implements every drawing rule faithfully (chamfer, groove, belt at δ, rimfire half-round, fillets, walls, solid head, pockets, all four bullet shapes, heeled case) and matches the reference proportions
Strong automated tests: numeric checks of each rule, label/line collision checks for all 25 records at 4 widths, e2e one-page print PDF and no-network checks
Clean technical presentation with title block, grouped tables, exact value/angle/tolerance formatting and a compact one-page A4 print
issues: Maintainability: no README, docs, ADRs, CI pipeline or runtime pin; Playwright config depends on a local Chromium cache path with --no-sandbox
Drawing conventions: all diameters stacked right of the tip with long extension lines hugging the outline; some labels displaced into other lanes (44 Rem. Mag. R); small label text
Minor data-presentation inaccuracies: spurious 'f' missing note on 22 LR, redundant 'deg' unit next to ° values, '1 cartridges'
review.verdict: A precise, well-tested, standards-aware cartridge reference whose drawing geometry and print output would satisfy reloaders and engineers. It falls short of publishable mainly on repository documentation and CI, plus some drafting refinements in where the diameter dimensions go.
